hit_check.resolution_note: Every printed rate in 3d and 3e is reproduced. The borderline case this note used to describe -- T3A-L8-2C11 at 701,135 RLU, one pixel from the 7e5 threshold -- came from the superseded bar-top rule and no longer exists (F-018). NOTE, so that nobody reads this as evidence the new rule is right: these rates reproduced on the OLD values too, including on 15 of 60 bars that were up to 28% high. A printed marginal cannot discriminate a geometric error of this kind. The bar tops are validated geometrically, per-bar, in provenance/review/round_2026-10-30/.
